data.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude

content.basic: Anthropic went public on November 19th, 2026. | Photo: Getty Images Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI's previous, often inelegant forays into the field. data.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent

content.basic: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a now-removed job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which said Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. An AI agent from Apple would put the iPhone maker in the running to compete with the likes of Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots, Anthropic's Duet, and Google's Tasks. data.title: I Don’t Trust Visual Recordings Anymore. But One Day I Will Again

content.basic: In March of this year, a flurry of emails and text messages from a half dozen reporters around the world disrupted my quiet Saturday morning. An Iranian news agency had aired a week-old video of what appeared to be a U.S.-made Tomahawk missile hitting a school. News reports claimed that the strike killed more than 175 people, most of them children. The U.S. president and military denied responsibility.
